item.content:encoded:
I felt so bad about running away from my parents. I ran because I thought if they had ever found out I liked girls I would have been disowned or committed to a nuthouse, but I never gave them a chance. Maybe I shouldn't have assumed the worst. They did love me, and lots of conservative parents become more tolerant after finding out their kid is gay. Maybe they would have too. I'll never know. All I know is that I broke their hearts.

This is very jarring and I cannot understand the thread of logic between this and its preceding sentences in the paragraph.

Other than that I would say this is a pretty decent work.

item.content:encoded:
Image source: Screenshot from He who gets slapped 1924, public domain according to https://archive.org/details/HeWhoGetsSlapped1924. ProcyonLotor said it was okay to use.

I don't know why there are 2 rating modules. If someone on the staff can fix that I would greatly appreciate it. Thanks Levi for fixing that.

Credit to The Great Hippo's latest SCP about Tobin Hollis's magic book, which inspired this rewrite.

Edit: It's come to my attention that at least a small number of readers think the Clown in the image is Icky. It's not. It's just a random Clown (his name is Slappy, if you're curious), which is why the poster is advertising Clowns in general and only mentions Icky at the end. I'm not an artist, and thus couldn't draw Icky, so I just grabbed the creepiest public domain image of a Clown I could find. There's a detailed description of Icky in Former Assets.

Double Edit: I've now replaced the image with one actually of Icky (courtesy of Zhange) to avoid this issue entirely. It's occurred to me that The Exploring Series may eventually do a video on Herman Fuller, and when they do I don't want them to present an image of Slappy as Icky.
